worldcombat.skill.afteryou.summary: Hand the initiative to a nearby, visible ally: it gains a window of faster actions while you take on a matching delay. When the ally acts inside the window it shouts 'After You!'.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.use.0: Let an ally act before your own beat
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.use.1: Pass the tempo over before an ally's big move
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.use.2: Flip the order of a combo
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.description.0: The ally gains %2$s points of skill haste for %1$s (cooldown scaled by 100/(100+haste)); its first action inside the window shouts 'After You!'.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.description.1: Choose an ally within %1$s blocks with a clear line of sight.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.description.2: The caster carries a %1$s delay of %2$s points; the thread takes %3$s, the recovery %4$s and the cooldown %5$s. Both haste and delay end with their effects.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.lead.0: Hurry: haste x1.2, window x0.7 — one hard push, but short.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.lead.1: Entrust: haste x0.85, window x1.4 — a steady stream that lets the ally take several beats.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.timing: Cast on an ally: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s, the cooldown %5$s from commit, and the current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.preference.le: Hurry: haste x1.2, window x0.7. Entrust: haste x0.85, window x1.4. Trade burst for duration.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.preference.ai: The partner only considers handing off while an ally is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger walks over to help.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to hand off.
